rationale: Price failed to break the session low of $64.11 after testing it multiple times over 75 minutes, resulting in a strong bounce on the highest 1-minute volume in the recent sequence (970k shares) that reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($64.51). With the primary thesis of a breakdown below $64.11 stalling and short-term momentum reversing upward, closing now locks in the remaining unrealized profit rather than risking a full round-trip toward the $65.51 stop. A flip to long is avoided due to the severe broader market weakness (SPY -1.81%) and overhead VWAP resistance at $65.65.
